description:
Start paid LTX 2.5 Alpha-Gen video background removal without green screen.

Produces a primary MP4 with source audio (`background_mode` = `checkerboard`, `solid` hex color,
or owned `image` cover), a transparent VP9 WebM (`output.webm_alpha_url`), a grayscale matte MP4
(`output.matte_video_url`), and optional full-resolution ProRes 4444 `.mov` (`include_prores=true`,
`output.prores_alpha_url`, retained for 30 days in storage). Poll `GET /api/v1/videos/generations/{id}`.

background_image_url.description: Owned background image from your uploads or results when background_mode='image'.
background_image_url.title: Background Image Url

background_mode.description: Background composited into the primary MP4 ('checkerboard', 'solid', or 'image').
background_mode.title: Background Mode

include_prores.description: When true, also stores the full-resolution ProRes 4444 (.mov) with alpha and audio (30-day retention).
include_prores.title: Include Prores

max_cost_rub.description: Optional maximum approved price in RUB from /videos/alpha-gen/estimate.
max_cost_rub.title: Max Cost Rub

resolution.description: Target ceiling resolution ('1080p', '1440p', '2160p', or 'source'). Smaller clips are never upscaled.
resolution.title: Resolution

video_url.description: Source video from your own uploads or results (<=200 MiB, 2..3072 frames, <=130 s).
video_url.title: Video Url

webhook_url.description: Optional HTTPS webhook URL notified when the job finishes.
webhook_url.title: Webhook Url

name: create_video_alpha_gen
